title: GPT-5 Mini and Nano join the model lineup
summary:
A small engine-tuning day: more GPT-5 options, smoother queue throughput, and better context for proxied requests.

Configured GPT-5 Mini and Nano for the text endpoint, giving builders more small-model options through the same familiar API.

Fixed a queue concurrency bottleneck and refined rate-limit intervals, so parallel requests can move through more reliably instead of forming an unnecessary little traffic jam.

Forwarded x-enter-token and x-github-id headers with proxied requests, preserving the context services need when requests travel through the proxy layer.
